title: Alle Vögel sind schon da - Ein fröhliches Frühlingslied für Kleinkinder
description: Der Frühling ist da und alle Vögel singen! Sing und klatsch mit uns. #kinderlied #kinderlieder #frühlingslied #mitmachlied #kleinkindlieder
characters: Three adorable Black toddlers: Zuri, a 3-year-old girl with deep warm brown skin, round afro puffs tied with soft yellow fabric scrunchies, wearing a sunny yellow t-shirt, denim dungaree shorts and white sneakers; Kofi, a 4-year-old boy with medium-deep brown skin, short dark natural curly hair, wearing a blue t-shirt, grey jogger shorts and red sneakers; and Nala, a 3-year-old girl with deep brown skin, neat cornrow braids, wearing a yellow pinafore dress over a white t-shirt, white tights and pink sneakers

verses.scene: A bright spring morning in a blossoming garden; small round cartoon birds hop along a branch as the three toddlers point up in delight.
The cartoon birds open their beaks to sing; little musical notes float in the sunny air while the toddlers cup their ears and smile.

lines: Sing und klatsch mit mir mit
verses.scene: The three toddlers clap their hands together in the blooming garden, grinning at the camera.
Cartoon flowers open across a green meadow as the toddlers spin with arms wide under falling blossom petals.

pd_source.author: August Heinrich Hoffmann von Fallersleben
pd_source.public_domain: Author died 1874 — life+70 expired 1944; pre-1929. Public domain worldwide.
pd_source.adaptation: First verse verbatim; a newly-written refrain 'Sing und klatsch mit mir mit' is the repeated hook. Only the words are used; ACE-Step makes a new melody.

song_style: children's nursery rhyme, bright cheerful springtime kids song, cute female child voice, simple very repetitive catchy melody, light bouncy tempo, warm and sunny, sung in German
